subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is: Yatch.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling should be 'Yacht'.
 
• Yacht means a large boat with a motor, used for pleasure.
 
 
• Example -* If you're on a cargo ship, you're probably at work; if you're on a **yacht**, it's probably your day off.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4 which is incorrectly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Snatch means to take something with a quick rough movement.
 
• Batch means a number of things or people which belong together as a group.
 
• Catch means to take hold of something that is moving, usually with your hand or hands.
